description_en: Deletes an IP address from the blacklist for critical event protection
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-major-protection-black-ip --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 5332 --rule-id 20013135 --ip-list 192.0.XX.XX,192.0.XX.XX/24 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteMajorProtectionBlackIp

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to obtain the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html获取当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the critical event protection template
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IP address blacklist rule for critical event protection
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The IP address blacklist to be deleted. Supports custom IP addresses or IP address segments in the blacklist, and supports both IPv4 and IPv6. Multiple IP addresses are separated by commas (,). For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的IP黑名单。支持自定义IP或IP段黑名单，同时支持IPv4和IPv6。多个IP之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/425591.html
parameters.name: ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the WAF instance. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: The Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: Outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
